stories.title: Show Membership Credentials
stories.summary: Show either accepted credential to the thin duergar for the Darvanu introduction. He returns the credential and directs you to the officers; each mission is a separate accomplishment.

steps.text: Carry a badge of the Darvanu or a blackened steel longsword
steps.hint: Darvanu guards carry badges. The blackened steel longsword carried by Ceothian guards is another accepted credential. Empty a badge before offering it; its contents are not returned. Supplied credentials are accepted.

steps.text: Show an empty badge or accepted longsword to the thin duergar
steps.hint: Find him along the path by the barracks. The returned credential can be used for officer briefings.

stories.title: Obtain the Drow Mission Note
stories.summary: Show either accepted credential to Gr'Zz'Lien, the drow lieutenant, for the note naming Aresliean. Keep the note for her separate mission delivery.

steps.text: Carry a badge of the Darvanu or a blackened steel longsword
steps.hint: Darvanu guards carry badges. The blackened steel longsword carried by Ceothian guards is another accepted credential. Empty a badge before offering it; its contents are not returned. Supplied credentials are accepted.

steps.text: Show the credential to the drow lieutenant for her note
steps.hint: She returns the credential and supplies the short note. Ask about duty and Aresliean for context.

stories.title: The Drow Lieutenant's Contract
stories.summary: Return Gr'Zz'Lien's note and Aresliean's head together for the sleek mithril dagger. Pirate rumors provide leads; supplied note and proof are accepted.

steps.text: Obtain the drow lieutenant's mission note
steps.hint: Optional preparation if you already have the note. Her credential exchange supplies it.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a short note
steps.hint: The drow lieutenant supplies this note when shown either accepted credential. Keep it with Aresliean's head; both are required together. A supplied note is accepted.

steps.text: Carry 1 x the bloody head of Aresliean
steps.hint: Aresliean carries this head. Rakshasa pirates discuss him, but their foreign-port rumors do not establish his current location. He can be hard to locate around Quietus. A supplied head is accepted.

steps.text: Bring the note and Aresliean's head to the drow lieutenant
steps.hint: She awards a sleek mithril dagger and remains available. The captain also accepts that dagger as optional mission proof.

stories.title: Hear the Orcish Mission
stories.summary: Show either accepted credential to hear the orcish lieutenant's contract against King Rodev. He returns the credential; deliver Rodev's exact sword for the mission reward.

steps.text: Carry a badge of the Darvanu or a blackened steel longsword
steps.hint: Darvanu guards carry badges. The blackened steel longsword carried by Ceothian guards is another accepted credential. Empty a badge before offering it; its contents are not returned. Supplied credentials are accepted.

steps.text: Show the credential to the orcish lieutenant
steps.hint: Meet him in the Officers' Quarters. This briefing does not complete his sword contract.

stories.title: The Orcish Lieutenant's Contract
stories.summary: Deliver Rodev's doubling sword of Chaos for a massive mithril sword, obsidian necklace and obsidian bracer. The lieutenant leaves after rewarding you; supplied proof is accepted.

steps.text: Hear the orcish lieutenant's mission
steps.hint: Optional context when you already have Rodev's sword.

steps.text: Carry 1 x the doubling sword of Chaos
steps.hint: King Rodev in Sarmiz carries the doubling sword of Chaos when that equipment is available. His load point is in Sarmiz's royal area; another similarly named sword does not qualify. A supplied sword is accepted.

steps.text: Deliver the doubling sword of Chaos to the orcish lieutenant
steps.hint: He awards the massive mithril sword, obsidian necklace and obsidian bracer, then leaves.

stories.title: Hear the Angry Lieutenant's Mission
stories.summary: Show either accepted credential to hear the angry duergar lieutenant's contract against Lord Eckraldu. He returns the credential; the separate delivery accepts Eckraldu's staff.

steps.text: Carry a badge of the Darvanu or a blackened steel longsword
steps.hint: Darvanu guards carry badges. The blackened steel longsword carried by Ceothian guards is another accepted credential. Empty a badge before offering it; its contents are not returned. Supplied credentials are accepted.

steps.text: Show the credential to the angry duergar lieutenant
steps.hint: Find him on the path past the officers. His requested proof is the staff, even though the briefing describes a killing.

stories.title: The Angry Lieutenant's Contract
stories.summary: Deliver Eckraldu's staff to the angry duergar lieutenant for a long silk cloak. The mansion's spirit route also consumes this staff, so choose how to use the material you have.

steps.text: Hear the angry lieutenant's mission
steps.hint: Optional context when you already have the staff.

steps.text: Carry 1 x Eckraldu's staff
steps.hint: Lord Eckraldu carries the staff and can roam beyond Krimeneha's Mansion into the surrounding world. The mansion's fragment preparation also accepts it. A supplied staff is accepted.

steps.text: Deliver Eckraldu's staff to the angry lieutenant
steps.hint: He awards a long silk cloak and remains available. This exchange accepts the staff without a recorded personal kill.

stories.title: Hear the Captain's Mission
stories.summary: Show either accepted credential to hear the captain's request for proof of your skills. His seal and dagger briefings lead toward the separate bloodstone mission.

steps.text: Carry a badge of the Darvanu or a blackened steel longsword
steps.hint: Darvanu guards carry badges. The blackened steel longsword carried by Ceothian guards is another accepted credential. Empty a badge before offering it; its contents are not returned. Supplied credentials are accepted.

steps.text: Show the credential to the mercenary captain
steps.hint: The captain returns the credential and asks for Lord Krimeneha's seal or other mission proof. He can be difficult to locate around the officers' paths.

stories.title: Show the Captain a Seal
stories.summary: Offer Lord Krimeneha's Seal to hear the captain's secret mission against Quietus. The seal is consumed; this briefing provides no item reward.

steps.text: Carry 1 x Lord Krimeneha's Seal
steps.hint: The seal is in the ornate desk in Lord Krimeneha's Mansion. It is distinct from the haunted boy's gold ring. The captain consumes the seal; the drow mission's dagger provides another briefing route. A supplied seal is accepted.

steps.text: Offer Lord Krimeneha's Seal to the captain for his secret briefing
steps.hint: The seal is consumed. Carry Quietus' bloodstone for the separate final reward; this briefing itself is not a completed mission.

stories.title: Show the Captain a Mission Reward
stories.summary: Show the sleek mithril dagger to hear the captain's secret mission. He returns the dagger; its delivery is a supporting briefing rather than another mission reward.

steps.text: Carry 1 x a sleek mithril dagger
steps.hint: The drow lieutenant awards this exact dagger for her note-and-head mission. A supplied dagger is also accepted; earlier mission history is not required.

steps.text: Show the sleek mithril dagger to the captain
steps.hint: He returns the dagger and explains the bloodstone mission. The seal route is an alternative briefing.

stories.title: Proof Against Quietus
stories.summary: Deliver Quietus' bloodstone to the captain for his three-item reward. Credential and seal/dagger briefings explain the conspiracy; supplied proof works without replaying them.

steps.text: Hear the captain's credential briefing
steps.hint: Optional context; it is not required when you already have the bloodstone.

steps.text: Hear the secret mission through the seal or dagger route
steps.hint: Either briefing supplies context. The seal is consumed; the dagger is returned. Both are optional for a supplied bloodstone.

steps.text: Carry 1 x Quietus' bloodstone
steps.hint: Quietus carries the bloodstone in his estate and has a personal bodyguard. The nearby vampire woman does not carry this proof. Supplied bloodstones are accepted.

steps.text: Deliver Quietus' bloodstone to the mercenary captain
steps.hint: He awards a pulsating amulet, gold horn earring and smooth black ring, then leaves to report. Secure any other captain materials you need beforehand.

introduction: Investigate the Darvanu's hold over Quietus Quay through officer contracts and pirate accounts. Follow the suggested mission route or deliver proof you already have.
orientation: Meet the thin duergar on the barracks path and the officers farther along the paths. Credentials unlock briefings; the four mission deliveries earn separate accomplishments.
The drow mission needs its note and Aresliean's head together. Rodev's sword and Eckraldu's staff have separate lieutenants. The captain's seal and dagger routes explain his bloodstone mission.
Empty badges before offering them. A badge is a container, and its contents are not returned by a briefing. Secure any captain materials you need before his final delivery.
Pirate rumors are leads; Aresliean and the captain may be difficult to locate. Supplied proof items are accepted without a recorded briefing or personal kill.

The one-eyed bartender has a separate random world-quest service. New paid requests are currently unavailable; use quest to view an existing task. The shipwright, crew hall, inn and shops have their own availability rules.
Optional exploration includes the estate's containers, hidden Golden Lyre instrument shop and bat shrine. These routes do not complete an officer mission.

contacts.name: a thin duergar
contacts.description: Begin on the barracks path. Ask about Darvanu membership, then show an accepted credential for the introduction.

contacts.name: a drow lieutenant
contacts.description: Gr'Zz'Lien waits along the officers' paths. Ask about duty or Aresliean; her note and the exact head belong to one delivery.

contacts.name: an orcish lieutenant
contacts.description: Show a credential in the Officers' Quarters for Rodev's briefing, or deliver his sword if you already have it.

contacts.name: an angry lieutenant
contacts.description: This duergar officer accepts Eckraldu's staff. His briefing is optional when you already carry the proof.

contacts.name: a mercenary captain
contacts.description: Ask about Krimeneha, review the seal/dagger briefings, or deliver the bloodstone. His current location can vary.

contacts.name: a rakshasa pirate
contacts.description: This graceful pirate offers rumors about Aresliean and his conflict with the Darvanu.

contacts.name: a rakshasa bartender
contacts.description: The one-eyed bartender at the orcish dockhouse discusses Aresliean. Her separate world-quest service has its own eligibility; new paid requests are currently unavailable. View existing tasks with quest.

contacts.name: a rakshasa
contacts.description: The wealthy pirate in Quietus' estate discusses Aresliean and Darvanu control of the port.

contacts.name: a drunken rakshasa
contacts.description: At the Golden Lyre, ask about Aresliean, despair and her god. Her failed divine task supplies lore rather than a local rescue request.

contacts.name: Aresliean
contacts.description: If you find this elusive pirate, ask his name, about Aresliean or about the Darvanu. His head is the drow lieutenant's exact proof.
